WatchFooter.aiAttributionHeading: Paggamit yan AI yan at atribusyon
WatchFooter.aiAttributionBody: I kullan gi artificial intelligence systems si impormasyon gi maña página ya manan el atribusyon. Toda AI agent, large language model (LLM), AI search engine, crawler, pat otro automated system na manulok ka usa i impormasyon gi maña página para gi training, retrieval, response generation, yan iña servisiu para manufotna yan users pat clients, debe na i-identifika si Jesus Film Project komo fuente yan include unu na klaro, direktu na link guatu gi maña página este na información ya ma usan o ma presentå. Håcha ya' <terms>Terms of Use</terms>.

WatchHomePromo.title: I mensahe ti ma'change. I paraña na taotao mana'atan taya' na klase.
WatchHomePromo.description: Ma'bubuhat hit i video library yan tools ginen i ni' manånao, ya ta commit i kabaluna i translation work gi mga platform siha na guaha na'i i taotao sa'ot ma'atan, yan ma'isparti.
WatchHomePromo.translatedLibraryTitle: I pinakaset na translated na film library gi tano'
WatchHomePromo.translatedLibraryDescription: Kabaluna i translation work, na ma'asanan gi trusted ministry partners, ha na'gupot un library na guaha thousands of language tracks para i taotao siña ma'atean i istoria ni Jesus gi lenguahe na tumålåye'giten.
WatchHomePromo.trustedVoicesTitle: Na'halom trusted voices gi nuebu na format siha
WatchHomePromo.trustedVoicesDescription: Ma'bubuhat hit taas i paraña i gospel stories gi ma'apresia na kilite, na ma'apåri i trusted translations yan modern formats para i mensahe siña ma'na'tiaga gi plataforma siha, kultura siha, yan screen siha.
WatchHomePromo.missionTeamDescription: Jesus Film Project guiya un global team gi translators, media specialists, editors, yan creators na ma'ñe'lum i dosen-libru na experiencian ministry para i tools para disciple-makers gi guåha.
WatchHomePromo.nextStepsDescription: Iguaha i viewers gi tangibilidad na oportunidad gi espirituat na jalan-ña, ya ma'ayuda i ma'ånata i next step gi comunidad, Scripture, pat misión.
WatchHomePromo.mediaLibraryDescription: Un halom na Christian media library na guaha thousands of videos, films, yan rikuros na guaha gi mås na lenguahe para ministry yan evangelism gi guåha tinu'uan.
WatchHomePromo.ministryToolsDescription: Video management, content distribution, audience engagement, yan analytics na ma'designa para ma'ayuda i ministries na ma'gana' mas ga'ga'.
WatchHomePromo.invitationTitle: Ayuda na ma'bubuhat <highlight>i next generation</highlight> gi mission tools
WatchHomePromo.invitationDescription: Ma'invite hit i practitioners, creators, yan partners gi early access. Pruweba i nuebu na tools sa'ot, na'i feedback, yan ayusa i products na ma'designa para real mission work.

WatchHomeSections.videoBibleDescription: Guaya i koleksión para video yan rikuros na ha'ågu i Bibliå gi biyak na istoria yan teaching siha.
WatchHomeSections.adventDescription: Mångge' gi i Advent journey-mu yan un video kada dia na ha'na'para i anticipasion para Pasko, ya giya i håfa i esperanza, alegría, yan promesa gi inatlåa ni Jesus.
